sourceIdentityDisambiguation: The target is Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.InMemory.InMemoryUserStore<TUser> in test\InMemory.Test, and its InMemoryStore<TUser,TRole> subclass.
PasskeyConformance and PasskeyUI samples have different InMemoryUserStore<TUser> implementations in their own namespaces. Same-simple-name grep hits are not target consumers.
Identity.DefaultUI.WebSite.csproj links the target InMemoryUserStore.cs and Poco model source into another testasset assembly. Its source reuse is not execution of that testasset in this capsule.

selectedNativeConstruction.roleStore: InMemoryStoreTest.CreateTestContext constructs one InMemoryStore<PocoUser,PocoRole>. AddUserStore/AddRoleStore register the exact provided object as singleton for both interfaces in the test's service collection.
selectedNativeConstruction.baseUserStore: InMemoryUserStoreTest.CreateTestContext constructs one InMemoryUserStore<PocoUser>; AddUserStore registers that exact object as singleton.
selectedNativeConstruction.managerFactory: UserManagerSpecificationTestBase.CreateManager and IdentitySpecificationTestBase.CreateRoleManager create a context when none is supplied, set up real Identity DI and resolve public managers from a new provider. Explicit shared contexts are reused in other specification scenarios; no cross-test shared-store lifetime is inferred.
selectedNativeConstruction.fixture: The selected InMemoryUserStoreTest rows also instantiate their unchanged class fixture, which opens an in-memory SQLite connection. They are real discovered native tests, not the abstract specification support library by itself.
selectedNativeConstruction.conditionalRows: All eleven selected native methods are unconditional Facts. No theory rows are selected; every selected role/name/result is structurally reconciled.

sourceOnlyConstructionNotExecuted.functionalTest: FunctionalTest creates one InMemoryStore in each CreateTestServer service setup, registering the same instance for user and role interfaces in that host.
sourceOnlyConstructionNotExecuted.controllerTest: ControllerTest uses two separate AddSingleton<TService,TImplementation> registrations for user and role services; do not infer a single shared instance across those service descriptors.
sourceOnlyConstructionNotExecuted.defaultUITestasset: PocoUserStartup registers the linked-source base user store as a singleton. This hosted path was not built or run here.

lookups.construction: Readonly instance Dictionary<string,TRole>() with no explicit comparer; allocated with its store instance.
lookups.producer: Public RoleManager.CreateAsync/UpdateAsync ultimately call store CreateAsync/UpdateAsync, storing the supplied role object by Id. Public RoleManager.FindByIdAsync delegates the Id without name normalization.
lookups.removal: Store DeleteAsync removes the Id after its existing known-role check.
lookups.observed: Missing/hit, newly allocated equal string, exact object identity, repeated lookups, second DI scope using the same store, case-distinct Id values, same-object and replacement-object updates, deletion and unaffected case-distinct control.

lookups.construction: Readonly instance Dictionary<string,TUser>() with no explicit comparer; key is GetLoginKey(provider,key), string concatenation provider + | + key.
lookups.producer: Real UserManager.AddLoginAsync first performs FindByLoginAsync, then calls the real store AddLoginAsync. The store appends the Poco login record and stores the original user object under the composed string key.
lookups.removal: Real RemoveLoginAsync removes the matching Poco login record and assigns null at the dictionary key; it does not Dictionary.Remove that key. The public removed lookup returns null. A manager re-add succeeds through the actual existing-key/null-value path.
lookups.observed: Missing/hit, separately allocated equal tuple components, exact user identity, repeated lookup, provider/key case distinctions, normal same-object update, duplicate rejection, removal/repeat-null/re-add/second-removal and unaffected case controls in both base and inherited store instances. Actual pipe-composed-key aliases and empty components are separately observed.

lookups.construction: Readonly instance Dictionary<string,TUser>() with no explicit comparer.
lookups.producer: Public UserManager.CreateAsync/UpdateAsync ultimately call real store CreateAsync/UpdateAsync, both assigning the exact provided user object at user.Id. Public UserManager.FindByIdAsync delegates Id without name normalization.
lookups.removal: Store DeleteAsync removes user.Id after its existing known-user check.
lookups.observed: Missing/hit, newly allocated equal string, exact user identity, repeated lookup, reused store across manager scopes, case-distinct Ids, same-object/replacement-object updates, removal/repeated miss and unaffected case control in both base and inherited store instances.

observationLimits: No lookup instrumentation, probe counts, cardinality/frequency measurement, timing, allocation metric or benefit/outcome decision.
